items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: I heard every clarinetist you could mention in person, Monk. Benny Goodman, Artie Shaw, Jerry Wahl, Tommy Reynolds, Woody Herman...

ctx.x: You’re going from here — what time do you have to work tonight?

I don’t have to start until 8, 8:30. Remember this song? [Sol plays]. This is called the subtone of the clarinet. I once heard Benny Goodman do this on the Camel Caravan show when he played “Poor Butterfly.” He did this, Monk. [Sol plays]. He once did that, it broke me up, how he went from the high register to the lower register. His command of the clarinet was unbelievable. Believe me. I mean I heard every clarinetist you could mention in person, Monk. Benny Goodman, Artie Shaw, Jerry Wahl, Tommy Reynolds, Woody…
